title: dotbabel smoke report
description: Result of `deploy-ops.mjs smoke`. A header value read from the environment never appears in this payload (SEC-8); only the header NAME is reported.

verdict.description: not_configured when no target declares smoke checks and not_run for a dry run; both are exit 0 outcomes, not failures. A consumer must read this (or dry_run) rather than inferring success from the exit code alone.

budget_exceeded.description: True when the run stopped on the 300-second total bound (PERF-6), leaving later checks unrun.

ok.description: null for a check listed by a dry run and never executed — distinct from false (ran and failed) and true (ran and passed).

attempts.description: 0 only for a dry-run entry, which was planned but never executed.

url.description: Present for http checks. Credentials are rejected before a request is made, so this never carries a userinfo component.

header_names.description: Names only. Values are read from named environment variables and are never serialized.

message.description: Redacted: any secret header value is replaced before this is written.

dry_run.description: True when --dry-run listed the checks without executing any. Present so a machine consumer can tell 'nothing ran' from 'everything passed' — without it, a stray --dry-run in a pipeline green-lights a release over zero executed checks.
